explication: mirrord runs a developer’s local process with Kubernetes target context, routing selected network, file, and environment behavior through an agent pod. The CLI resolves configuration and target, establishes the session, then the injected layer and agent provide runtime interception and cluster-side access. Documented enterprise capabilities include database branching, queue splitting, and preview environments. Edges are limited to README statements and explicit imports/calls visible in the supplied excerpts or SOURCE INDEX; unsampled subsystems are represented without guessed wiring.
